data.one_liner: A customizable analog clock widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Displays an analog clock with optional live updates and custom datetime. Offers extensive visual customization such as colors, numbers, ticks, and size. Works on all Flutter platforms.
use_when: You need an analog clock UI in a Flutter app
You want live time updates with custom styling
You require a lightweight, pure‑Flutter solution
avoid_when: You only need a digital clock
You need advanced time‑zone or scheduling logic
You require extensive testing or accessibility features
strengths: Live updating and manual datetime support
weaknesses: Only provides analog display, no digital alternative
Limited feature set beyond clock rendering
No built‑in tests or extensive documentation
data.minimal_example:
import 'package:analog_clock/analog_clock.dart';

AnalogClock(
  decoration: BoxDecoration(
    border: Border.all(width: 2.0, color: Colors.black),
    shape: BoxShape.circle,
  ),
  width: 150.0,
  isLive: true,
  hourHandColor: Colors.black,
  minuteHandColor: Colors.black,
  showSecondHand: false,
  numberColor: Colors.black87,
  showNumbers: true,
  showAllNumbers: false,
  textScaleFactor: 1.4,
  showTicks: false,
  showDigitalClock: false,
  datetime: DateTime(2019, 1, 1, 9, 12, 15),
);
